event: "Bronze. You're the hall's now, and the hall's yours." "Thanks!"
Back at the bunk room you take up the practice spear; its blunt iron head is heavier than it looks.
Wat watches you go out with it. "Slimes? Mind your eyes, miss."
On the common some thirty small slimes bob in the grass; three children with jars work by the water.

memory.fact: This afternoon some thirty small slimes and five melon-sized ones dot the common.
Three jelly children work the common with jars, led by Tam Brewer, a boy of ten.

event: An old shepherd sits on a stile by the sheep, watching you.

memory.fact: An old shepherd, Dunny Carrow, minds the sheep from a stile and watches strangers.

event: You pick a fist-sized slime on dry ground. As you near it, it goes still, then drifts to you.

memory.fact: Near Nala the slimes grow calm and drift toward her; none flees her spear.
Near Nala the slimes grow calm and drift toward her; none flees her spear.
The slimes follow Nala about and grow calm near her.

event: A clumsy thrust; the blunt head punches through and meets the core with a small, hard crack.
The slime slumps into a puddle; its red core dulls to grey. "Blue Slime defeated."

changes.note: First blue slime killed: race experience

memory.fact: A killed slime slumps to a puddle of jelly around its core, which dulls from red to grey.
A killed slime slumps to a puddle of jelly around its core, which dulls from red to grey.
A kill notice reads "<Griffin LV 8 defeated. Experience gained.>".

event: You fish the core out; the jelly nettles your skin with a hot prickle, and you wipe it on the grass.

memory.fact: Slime jelly nettles bare skin at once with a hot prickle.
Slime jelly nettles bare skin at once with a hot prickle.

event: You work slowly on stance, grip, the step in. Every slime goes still and drifts to you, waiting.
By the fourth you can judge how deep the core sits; the thrust runs together into one motion.

changes.note: Four slimes down: race experience

event: You take seven in all, every one small, and keep well clear of the children's end.

memory.fact: Nala killed seven small slimes with the practice spear and pockets their seven grey cores.
Nala killed seven small slimes with the practice spear and pockets their seven grey cores.

event: A new line: Racial Experience threshold reached. Human is now LV 2.

changes.note: Seven slimes take her to Human LV 2
Experience carried past the LV 2 threshold, as the history holds
Human LV 2 brings her first trait point

memory.fact: A race level reads "<Racial Experience threshold reached. [race] is now LV 2.>".

event: Warmth runs through your limbs; the spear feels lighter, and your breathing settles deep and even.
Seven cores clink in the jerkin's inside pocket. On the stile, the old shepherd is still watching.
A melon-sized slime with a red stone rolls out of the long grass and bumps your boot.
"Oi! Not that one! That's mine!" A boy of ten, jelly to the elbows, plants himself before it.

memory.fact: A boy of about ten claims a melon-sized slime with a red stone as his, and warned Nala off it.
A boy of about ten claims a melon-sized slime with a red stone as his, and warned Nala off it.
Tam claims the fattest slimes as his own, and yells at anyone who spears one.

event: "You're welcome to it, lad. I'd never interfere with a great hunt like that."

changes.note: She lets Tam keep his fat slime and praises his hunt

memory.fact: Nala left the boy his red-stone slime to harvest, saying she'd never interfere with his hunt.
Nala left the boy his red-stone slime to harvest, saying she'd never interfere with his hunt.

event: He squints, suspicious of being agreed with, then grins and kneels with his jar.
You walk upstream past the footbridge, under a screen of willows hiding a grassy bend.

memory.fact: Upstream of the footbridge, a screen of willows hides a grassy bend from town and road.
Upstream of the footbridge, a screen of willows hides a grassy bend from town and road.
A few small slimes always bob in the willow bend, where the jelly children seldom go.

event: Three small slimes in the bend all turn toward you. "Hello. Can you hear me?" Blue and blank.
"Go left. Right. Stay." It only drifts an inch closer. You try it silently, willing it hard.

memory.fact: Nala's words and silent commands reach no slime; blue slimes have no mind to hear them.

event: The warmth behind your ribs stirs, like something huge turning in its sleep. All three shiver close.

memory.fact: When Nala stirs the warmth behind her ribs, nearby slimes shiver and press toward her.
When Nala stirs the warmth behind her ribs, nearby slimes shiver and press toward her.

event: You push the warmth at the nearest. The air creases like a folded sheet, and lies flat again.
The slime is a hand's width farther off. It never rolled. A small cool sip leaves you.

changes.note: The first fold takes a sip of her mana

memory.fact: Pushed at a slime with intent, her warmth folds space round it and jerks it a hand's width.
Pushed at a slime with intent, her warmth folds space round it and jerks it a hand's width.
That fold is her first working of Dimension Magic, and drains a sip of her mana.
That fold is her first working of Dimension Magic, and drains a sip of her mana.

event: A window opens. New skill acquired: [Dimension Magic LV 1].

make.title: Dimension Magic
make.description: Magic that folds space, shifting a thing straight toward her or away from her.

changes.note: Her first fold gives her Dimension Magic LV 1
First working of Dimension Magic: race experience, as the history holds

memory.fact: Her one decisive advantage is Dimension Magic from a pure legacy affinity, at level one.
Her first working of Dimension Magic shows its line in her status, and its spells as found.

event: You pull, and the air creases; the slime is back at your boot. A second sip goes.

changes.note: The pull back takes a second sip

event: You try to fold it sideways, toward the brook. The warmth won't answer; the slime stays.

memory.fact: The fold moves the slime only toward her or away; she cannot yet steer it anywhere else.
